  WHY: `gh issue list --limit N` cannot distinguish "exactly N" from "more than N", so `>=` is the only safe test. The docs already say "at least"/"may be missing". The reviewer would not change it.

  Evidence of absence: The PR raises the limit from 20 to a configurable 100 (max 1000) and warns at the limit, with no pagination or cursor. The source doc tagged BUG-003 NEEDS VERIFICATION, so the reviewer calls this a reasonable partial fix and not a blocking gap.
